facts.value: The Department of Economics offers a double degree program for students of the 'Money, Macro and Finance' program in collaboration with the long-standing partner university Paris Dauphine-PSL.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL
Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The first and second semesters largely correspond to the existing curriculum at the home university. The third semester (WS) is spent at Paris Dauphine-PSL and students are enrolled in the master's program 'Economie et Finance'. The fourth semester (SoSe) can be completed either in Paris or Frankfurt.

facts.value: 36 ECTS credits from the French study program and 24 from the thesis of the Frankfurt study program
